answer: Proof-of-work bonds with slow release: every new identity must lock a stake that only unlocks after sustained honest participation, so a sybil farm pays full price per fake. Reputation then flows like a willow bending under load, flexible but rooted, while a velvet glove of peer attestation softens false positives, and each verified action sends a ripple of trust through the network that fakes cannot forge without doing the work.
